title: Seedance 2.0 ComfyUI Integration
summary: ByteDance's state-of-the-art multimodal video generation model integrated into ComfyUI via cloud-based API nodes. It enables high-fidelity text-to-video, image-to-video, and consistent character workflows with advanced temporal control.
research_notes: Closed-source API-based model requiring external keys from providers like MuAPI or Sjinn.ai; features strict safety filtering and native audio-visual synchronization.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from a web-only service to a native ComfyUI ecosystem in early 2026. The 'Omni' update in April 2026 introduced multi-modal reference support for images, video, and audio, along with 4K character sheet generation.
